name: Bag of Beans Cafe & Restaurant
notes: 5 photos, all legible printed menu boards. 1 and 2 are duplicates of the drinks/cafe page; 3 and 4 are duplicates of the food page but 4 shows a slightly later price revision (Short Rib Adobo, Kare Kare, Sinigang, Soy Garlic Chicken & Waffles, Omelette raised; Fries renamed Truffle Fries) so its prices were used. Photo 5 is a separate, older-style bakery/dessert page with new items (Banana Split, tarts, croissants, cheesecakes, macarons) plus a Pandesal/Raisin Bread and Brioche Donut special with no per-unit price; its Cafe drink list duplicated items already captured from photo 1 and was not re-added. Beer, wine and cocktail (Specialty Libations) sections and the generic soft-drink/juice list were skipped as drink-only.
